extDescription.message: Lets an MCP client such as Claude Code read and operate your tabs. Sends page content, URLs and screenshots to a local native host.

popupFooter.message: Inari MCP for Firefox — sends page content only to the native host on this computer

setupHostMissingText.message: Firefox cannot find the InariMCP native host. Build InariMCP and run its installer in your InariMCP folder (a clone of the repository):

setupHostMissingNote.message: Then press Recheck. Flatpak Firefox: see the installation guide (re-running the installer alone does not help there).

setupHostErrorText.message: The native host is registered but did not work ($1). Re-running the installer fixes the usual cause, a Node.js that was upgraded or moved:

setupHostOutdatedTitle.message: Native host is out of date

setupHostOutdatedText.message: Browser tools still work, but your InariMCP folder is older than this extension. Pull the latest version there, rebuild it and re-run the installer (it updates the native host):

setupDaemonDownText.message: The native host runs, but the InariMCP server does not answer.

setupDaemonDownTextAt.message: The native host runs, but the InariMCP server does not answer at $1.

setupNoSessionText.message: Firefox is ready. Either InariMCP is not registered with Claude Code, or no Claude Code session is running. To register it:

setupNoSessionNote.message: After registering, restart Claude Code. A running session shows up here within about 30 seconds.

toastCopyFailed.message: Copy failed: select the command and copy it by hand

badgeHostOutdated.message: InariMCP: native host is out of date

badgeApprovalPending.message: InariMCP: $1 approval request(s) waiting for you

notifyApprovalDefault.message: Claude wants to perform an action

notifyApprovalToolCall.message: Allow $1 on $2? Click the InariMCP toolbar button to approve or deny.

notifyApprovalQuestion.message: $1 — answer with the InariMCP toolbar button.

notifyCaptchaMessage.message: Claude paused on a captcha and needs you to solve it.

bannerCaptchaTitle.message: 🧩 Please solve the captcha ($1), then it continues automatically.

bannerCaptchaDetail.message: InariMCP paused and is waiting for you. Click Done if it does not continue on its own.

approvalToolCallNote.message: Approve only if you asked for this. It allows this one call of this tool, with these arguments, on this site, and nothing else. $1 s left.

approvalMessageNote.message: Your answer goes back to Claude; it approves no tool call. $1 s left.

toastApprovalGone.message: This request is no longer pending

popupConsentText.message: Inari MCP for Firefox does not connect to the native host until you allow it on the permission page.

popupPauseNote.message: Paused: every command from the MCP client is refused.

toastPauseFailed.message: Could not change the pause switch

badgeTextNoConsent.description: Toolbar badge text (at most 4 characters): not allowed to connect yet

badgeNoConsent.message: InariMCP: not allowed yet (it does not connect). Open the popup to allow it.

badgeTextPaused.description: Toolbar badge text (at most 4 characters): agent actions paused

badgePaused.message: InariMCP: paused (commands from the MCP client are refused)

badgeActive.message: InariMCP: the MCP client is operating Firefox

consentHeading.message: Allow Inari MCP for Firefox to connect?

consentWhatText.message: Inari MCP for Firefox lets an MCP client on this computer (such as Claude Code) operate Firefox: read pages, take screenshots, click, type and manage tabs.

consentSendsText.message: The content of open pages, screenshots, URLs and the list of tabs. They go to the native host on this computer and from there to the MCP client, which may pass them on to its AI provider.

consentNeedsText.message: The InariMCP native host, installed separately on this computer. The add-on alone does nothing.

consentDenyTitle.message: If you do not allow it

consentDenyText.message: The add-on does not connect to the native host and does nothing. You can allow it later from the toolbar button.

consentStateGranted.message: Allowed. Inari MCP for Firefox connects to the native host. You can close this tab. To stop the agent at any time, use the pause switch in the toolbar popup.

consentStateDenied.message: Not allowed. Inari MCP for Firefox does not connect and does nothing. You can allow it later from the toolbar button.

consentStateFailed.message: Your answer could not be saved. Reload this page and try again.
